summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored lore destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, faction standing and resume location. Shared player behaviors connect authored spaces to generated layouts and encounters, while the common field-kit UI serves the HUD, menus, dialogue, inventory and journal; conversations now pair open-world subtitles with a bottom choice dock.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and generated dressing; cells/objects.scene also places the invisible Bulk Data Manager object.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells/.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destination doors, camps, crew and quest props; distinct from Bonus room routing.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation, waking, staged tutorial and HALOGEN handoff to Dina's lead.
places/level9 (3D, The Suburbs) - seeded streets and fitted, individually styled furnished houses; dark-house smilers and street encounters use the generated zones.
places/level11 (3D) - Sedco Spotlight and city blocks; sim.js builds subway, Sedco vault and Robotics crawl/storeroom, plus Dina's Chapter 2 clinic cache and sealed Level ! threshold.

places/level61 (3D) - Snackrooms food court and M.E.G. checkpoint/outpost: five interactive food/drink counters including Gib's Grub through the south wall, staged order trays, staffed storefronts, vending and jammed supply-room overflow; other lore destinations include Level ! an…

places/level01, level02, level1-7, level10-13, level21, level26-27, level31, level70, levelrun, gamma, spamton, testlab (3D) - authored lore destinations and test space; Level ! is the Chapter 2 chase corridor and Safe Alcove.
